messages:
Ivy: FYI seeing an eviction spike in ap-southeast1c hitting tiny GPU pods (tiny-*) since ~08:10. Cost trending up.
infra-bot: ALERT: gpu_evictions.ap-southeast1c = 4.9/min (10m avg).
Rohit: Any recent label/taint changes in that AZ?
Ivy: We rolled gpu.family=rtxA enforcement yesterday. Quick node sample: 
Labels: gpu.family=rtxA, nodepool=prod-tight
Taints: nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule
And older nodes still labeled rtx7. Many pods have required nodeAffinity to rtx7.
Maya: Scheduler log snippet shows bind failures: "Binding failed for pod ml/tiny-123: node(s) didn't match node affinity". Small pods pile onto rtx7 nodes -> evict when larger jobs land.
Ethan: Short fixes: 1) bump warm pool in that AZ, 2) temporarily change taint effect on a few rtxA nodes to PreferNoSchedule, 3) roll a mutating webhook to convert required->preferred for pods requesting <=1 GPU.
Ivy: I'll scale warmpool 6->14 for ap-southeast1c now.
infra-bot: RUNBOOK: warmpool scaled by Ivy at 2025-03-23T08:22:10Z (id rp-4610).
Rohit: I'll flip taint to PreferNoSchedule on 3 nodes in the pool as a hotfix.
Maya: Starting webhook canary in ml namespace to rewrite nodeAffinity for label ml:tiny. Canary target 10% initially.
infra-bot: METRIC: evictions.ap-southeast1c dropped to 1.2/min after actions.
Ethan: Opened TICKET-4610: "ap-southeast1c tiny-pod eviction wave due to gpu.family affinity enforcement" assigned infra/runtime. Long-term: audit remaining required affinities and add CI gate.
Ivy: Monitoring for 45m and will report back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
